en: The Training Rule on Weapons in Hand.
At that time, the Buddha, the Blessed One, was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Now at that time, the group-of-six monks were teaching the Dhamma to one who had a weapon in his hand...
[as before] ... "The training is to be observed: 'I will not teach the Dhamma to one who has a weapon in his hand and is not ill.
The Dhamma should not be taught to one who is not ill and has a weapon in hand.
Whoever, out of disrespect, teaches the Dhamma to one who is not ill and has a weapon in hand, commits an offense of wrong-doing (*dukkaṭa*).
There is no offense if it was unintentional ... [and so on] ... for one who is a beginner.
The tenth training rule is finished.
The sixth chapter, the Surusuru Chapter, is concluded.
